title: galium mollugo var. nevadense

It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Galium mollugo var. nevadense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
